title: 第5章 白毛精灵希娅第6章 危机降临
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 两天后，黑魔森林深处。
锋利的匕首从小鬼黏腻的脖颈间拔出，带出一串暗红的血珠。
林鬼迅速矮身，缩回茂密的草丛深处。
他动作麻利地掏出一把干涩的草木灰，均匀地覆盖在尸体上。
压下那令人作呕的浓重血腥气。
整个过程悄无声息，如同幽灵般利落。
他蜷缩在阴影里，像一尊石像，只有锐利的目光不断扫视着四周。
再三确认附近没有其他恶魔后。
他才像一只受惊的狸猫，悄无声息地从藏身之处滑了出来。
草木灰只能延缓一段时间。
用不了多久，这血腥的气息就会引来更多嗜血的恶魔。
不想被闻讯而来的恶魔群包围。
林鬼只能冒险，离开了潜伏了三个小时的临时庇护所。
原定几日就能穿越的路程，5天了，林鬼都没有离开。
如今被死死地困在，这片越发诡异的黑魔森林里。
原因很简单......
不知道是哪来的傻叉冒险团，组团来黑魔森林讨伐传奇恶魔。
那动静，将整个黑魔森林的恶魔，都惊动了。
如今黑魔森林到处都是恶魔的响动。
从一个灌木丛疾奔到另一个草丛。
借助着茂密杂草的掩护。
林鬼背着那鼓囊囊、沉甸甸的背包，进行着一次又一次惊险的转移。
耳边，一个浅蓝色、只有指甲盖大小的小型魔法圆环，正在微弱地跳动、旋转着。
在高阶风系魔法【风聆术】的加持下。
方圆百米内的声音被放大、过滤，清晰地传入他的耳中。
同时，【风行术】的微弱气流，缠绕在他的腿脚之上，让他的脚步轻盈迅捷。
耳边不断有恶魔窜动的声音响起。
他依靠风声捕捉着一切动静。
在判断出短暂的安全间隙后，便立刻全力冲刺。
汗水浸透了他的法袍，紧紧贴在背上。
直到一处下坡的山谷地带。
一阵混杂着哭喊、绝望咒骂以及令人牙酸的、某种东西被咀嚼撕扯的可怕声音，顺着风清晰地递到了他的耳边。
林鬼心中一凛，猛地停下脚步。
糟糕的是，他正欲转身改变路线。
身后，一阵杂乱而急促的脚步声正由远及近，迅速传来！
声音越来越大，越来越密集，正飞速逼近他所在的位置。
林鬼皱紧眉头，牙关紧咬。
他很清楚，对于某些感知敏锐的强大恶魔而言。
在这种距离下，仅仅躲在草丛里，无异于自欺欺人。
content_en:
Two days later, deep in the Dark Forest.
"Tsk——"
The sharp dagger was pulled out from the imp's sticky neck, bringing out a string of dark red blood beads.
The forest ghost quickly dwarfed and retreated deep into the dense grass.
He quickly took out a handful of dry plant ash and evenly covered the body.
Suppress the nauseating heavy smell of blood.
The whole process was as silent as a ghost.
He huddled in the shadows, like a stone statue, with only his sharp eyes constantly scanning the surroundings.
After double-checking that there are no other demons nearby.
Like a frightened raccoon cat, he slipped out of his hiding place silently.
Plant ash can only delay it for a while.
It won't be long before this bloody aura will attract more bloodthirsty demons.
I don’t want to be surrounded by the demons who came after hearing the news.
Lin Gui could only take risks and left the temporary shelter where he had been lurking for three hours.
The journey that was originally planned to be traversed in a few days, has been five days, and Lin Gui has not left.
Now he is trapped in this increasingly weird dark forest.
The reason is simple...
I don’t know where the silly adventure group came from, and they came to the Dark Forest to fight against the legendary demon.
The movement alerted all the demons in the Dark Forest.
Nowadays, the Dark Forest is filled with the sounds of demons.
Sprinting from one bush to another.
Under the cover of dense weeds.
Lin Gui carried the bulging and heavy backpack and made thrilling transfers again and again.
Next to his ear, a small light blue magic ring, only the size of a fingernail, was beating and spinning weakly.
Under the blessing of high-level wind magic [Wind Listening Technique].
The sounds within a hundred meters radius were amplified, filtered, and clearly transmitted to his ears.
At the same time, the weak air current of [Wind Movement Technique] wrapped around his legs and feet, making his steps light and swift.
The sound of demons scurrying around kept ringing in my ears.
He relied on the sound of the wind to capture all movements.
After judging the short safety gap, he immediately sprinted with all his strength.
Sweat soaked his robe and clung to his back.
Until a downhill valley area.
A mixture of cries, desperate curses, and a heart-wrenching, terrifying sound of something being chewed and torn came clearly to his ears along the wind.
Lin Gui felt a chill in his heart and stopped suddenly.
Worse, he was about to turn around and change course.
Behind him, a burst of chaotic and rapid footsteps came quickly from far to near!
The sound was getting louder and denser, and it was rapidly approaching his location.
Lin Gui frowned and gritted his teeth.
He knew very well that for some powerful demons with keen senses.
At this distance, just hiding in the grass is tantamount to fooling yourself and others.
